events.title: Woodstock '69 Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began in Bethel, New York, on this day in 1969, attracting nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Peace & Music Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the original Woodstock, its message of peace and music still resonates. What's your favourite iconic performance from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away in Memphis, Tennessee, on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we're remembering the one and only Elvis Presley. Which of his timeless hits is on your playlist today?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Power
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! We're celebrating with a Pretenders classic – what's your go-to track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! We're cranking up an Oasis anthem in his honour. What's your top Gallagher moment?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut. Which Bond theme tune is the most iconic for you?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music icon and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary actor and comedian, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The incomparable Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in London on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we pay tribute to the showman supreme, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
